title: hint$^2$: Hierarchical World Models for Inference-Time Temporal Logic Guidance
description:
arXiv:2608.13678v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A central goal of robot learning is to enable robots to execute rich instructions specified at runtime. Large-scale language-conditioned policies have made substantial progress toward this goal, yet still struggle with temporal structure and safety constraints.
